the torque-angle diagrams for muscles are of great value in the understanding of the mechanical properties of the muscular system, and that these diagrams are a valuable tool in the study of the function of the muscular system.

a distinction between different muscle types is impossible on the basis of a simple goniometric analysis of the geometry of muscle attachment.
